verdict.rationale: Shopify supports background automation primarily via webhooks that trigger app actions on store events, and through the newer agentic/UCP tooling for building agents that can monitor orders and act on a store's behalf. However, this requires custom app/agent development rather than a built-in no-code automation feature, and there's no evidence of a native scheduler or persistent background-agent runtime (e.g., Shopify Flow) in the pack. Missing for 10: evidence of a no-code/native automation builder, evidence of persistent/scheduled background execution, and a concrete example of an automation running unattended end-to-end.
